column3: “They will belong to him the side of the east, the sea” is rendered “running from east to west.”
“The contribution which you will offer up” is rendered “the allotment which you shall set apart.”
“The contribution of holiness” is rendered “the holy allotment”; NASB adds “namely.”
“Consecrated” is rendered “sanctified” (plural), and “people of Israel” “sons of Israel.”
“A holy place of holy places” is rendered “a most holy place.”
“Make pass over” is rendered “alienate,” and “the choicest” “this choice portion.”
“A profane area” is rendered “for common use.”
NASB renders “and from” as “exclusive of” and supplies “everything.”
NASB renders “from inheritance” as “for an inheritance” and adds “several.”
